instruction: Put the red pen in the green pen case.

attempts.code:
candidates = grasp_candidates("red_pen")
best_candidate = None
best_score = -1
for c in candidates:
    yaw_diff = abs(c["yaw"] - 1.249)
    if c["fits_open_fingers"] and abs(yaw_diff) < 0.2 and c["score"] > best_score:
        best_candidate = c
        best_score = c["score"]
grasp(best_candidate)
spots = free_spots("green_case", "red_pen")
target_spot = spots["spots"][0]
carry_to(target_spot["x"], target_spot["y"], height=0.18, yaw=target_spot["object_long_axis_yaw"])
lower_until_contact()
open_gripper()
retreat()
check("red_pen", "green_case")
